prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop web-app screenshot for GO Itaim’s existing “Dashboard Geral”, landscape 16:10, roughly 1440×900. Show the app canvas only: no browser chrome, no device frame, no poster. Use the attached GO Itaim logo asset in the upper-left sidebar. Do not redesign the brand.

This is the “Folhas de Operação” direction: warm ivory work surface, dark ink, cobalt matching the brand, chrome-yellow section tab, oxide-red only for errors, restrained stepped section dividers along the far-right edge, one clear acetate-like sheet edge. Use a condensed grotesk for headings, readable text and tabular numerals. Physical material is a subtle organizing detail; all information stays crisp, contemporary, and functional.

The screenshot MUST include both real controls that were missing from the earlier proposal:

A) At the very top, a 64px application header across the main workspace: left breadcrumb “Principal › Visão Geral”; in the center a persistent clipped horizontal ticker with a green refresh icon and the word “Sincronizado”, then city/date pairs scrolling right-to-left: “Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09”. Show fade masks at both ends so it is visibly a moving marquee. On the far right show small theme and user/avatar controls. The city names and dates are illustrative placeholders, not claims.
B) Immediately below the header, a wide sticky filter panel with every current global filter visible and legible. It takes about 120px and uses two clean rows:
Row 1: label “Período”, a clear segmented switch “Ano/Semana” | “Intervalo” with Ano/Semana selected; dropdown “Ano 2026”; multi-select “Semana 05, 06, 07”.
Row 2: dropdowns “Praça Todas”, “Sub praça Todas”, “Origem Todas”, “Turno Todos”, plus a compact “Limpar” action. Use actual filter controls, not summary chips. Preserve the labels and the multi-select behavior.
The hierarchy is clear: header ticker first, all filters second, content third.

Below the filters, show a real operational overview:
- A left sidebar about 230px wide with the supplied logo, “Dashboard Geral”, and exact current groups/items: “Principal” → “Visão Geral”, “Análise”, “UTR”, “Comparação”; “Operacional” → “Entregadores”, “Valores”, “Prioridade | Promo”, “Evolução”, “Dedicado”; “Marketing” → “Operacional Marketing”, “Marketing”. “Visão Geral” is selected.
- Main title “Resumo Operacional”.
- Three aligned first-read values: “Corridas ofertadas 18.450”, “Aderência 74,8%”, “Praças 2”.
- Lower left: a small line chart “Evolução diária” with “Ofertadas” and “Aceitas”. Lower right: a table “Por praça” with columns “Praça”, “Corridas”, “Aderência”; rows “Guarulhos”, “Centro”, “Total”.
Use only the listed Portuguese labels. Keep controls and data readable without overlapping the sticky panel. Values and ticker dates are illustrative.
demoData: City/date pairs and metric rows are illustrative placeholders.
